title: CyriPanel: CYP2D6 genotyping from targeted capture panels
description:
CyriPanel genotypes CYP2D6 star alleles from targeted capture sequencing. It adapts the paralog-aware framework of Cyrius and the BCyrius allele table, and estimates copy number against diploid reference samples sequenced with the same assay.

This release accompanies the preprint CyriPanel for CYP2D6 Genotyping from Targeted Capture Panels Using Assay-Matched Diploid References. The benchmark/ directory holds the reference-standard diplotypes, the per-evaluation results for CyriPanel and Aldy 4, and the analysis scripts. benchmark/README.md lists the script or data source behind each table.

CyriPanel is research software. The benchmark measured analytical concordance in reference cell lines and is not a clinical validation.
notes: Changes from v1.0.1 are in the documentation, two code comments and the benchmark folder. The analysis scripts behind the preprint's tables were added, and the columns of a superseded reference standard were removed from the benchmark records. Site-specific deployment files were removed. The calling logic is unchanged.
